'''2020 EGP Kyle Krueger LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Kyle Krueger]] at [[2020 Endor Grand Prix]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Kyle Krueger]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Endor Grand Prix]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open WYS Krueger LS 2020 EGP.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2020-endor-grand-prix/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20200804023225/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2020-endor-grand-prix/ Internet Archive]
